exact_claim: On a closed oriented smooth 3-manifold, a global C1 contact form omega satisfying d alpha=alpha wedge omega for a nowhere-zero C1 form alpha defining a cooriented taut C2 foliation without spherical leaves is tight. This answers the conditional Calegari Question 13.2, not the existence question 13.1.
